title: SiteShrimp Photo Entry — Handover Walkthrough variant
description: Variant for pre-handover snag list inspections — the final walkthrough before keys are handed over. Tracks unit / room context for room-by-room reporting and a sign-off owner so each defect is routed to the responsible party (developer / contractor / sub-trade) for rectification before TOP / handover acceptance.

unit_no.description: Unit / apartment / townhouse number being walked through. Empty when the entry covers a common area.

room.description: Specific room within the unit. Drives room-by-room handover report grouping.

signoff_owner.description: Party responsible for accepting / rectifying this defect at handover. Routes the snag to the right approver.
